definitions.gloss: to carry back; to transfer back (funds)
definitions.explanation: An accounting, tax and public-finance word: to carry a loss back against an earlier year, or to return transferred money to the account or fund it came from.

examples.japanese: ⟦{余|あま}った→余る：00001_amaru⟧⟦{予算|よさん}→予算：03663_yosan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{一般会計|いっぱんかいけい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{繰|く}り{戻|もど}した。
examples.english: The unused budget was transferred back to the general account.

examples.japanese: {取|と}り{崩|くず}した⟦{分|ぶん}→分：26216_bun⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{来年度|らいねんど}→来年度：28221_rainendo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{基金|ききん}→基金：20400_kikin⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧{繰|く}り{戻|もど}す⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧だ。
examples.english: The amount drawn down is to be returned to the fund next fiscal year.

examples.japanese: ⟦{赤字|あかじ}→赤字：04712_akaji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{前年|ぜんねん}→前年：23906_zennen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{利益|りえき}→利益：03673_rieki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{繰|く}り{戻|もど}して⟦{税金|ぜいきん}→税金：03308_zeikin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{還付|かんぷ}→還付：23499_kanpu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けた→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: I received a tax refund by carrying back the deficit against the previous year's profits.

notes:
USAGE:
- A specialist word. In tax and accounting it means carrying a loss back to offset an earlier year's profits; in budgeting, returning money to the account it was transferred from.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{損失|そんしつ}→損失：04875_sonshitsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{繰|く}り{戻|もど}す (to carry back a loss)
- {繰戻還付|くりもどしかんぷ} (loss carryback refund)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{繰|く}り{越|こ}す→繰り越す：31803_kurikosu⟧: to carry forward (to future periods)

WATCH OUT:
- To rewind a tape or turn back time is ⟦{巻|ま}き{戻|もど}す→巻き戻す：15915_makimodosu⟧: ⟦テープ→テープ：01535_teepu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{巻|ま}き{戻|もど}す→巻き戻す：15915_makimodosu⟧, ⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{巻|ま}き{戻|もど}す→巻き戻す：15915_makimodosu⟧.
